commitments.detail: Security will be present at the South Gate to manage the crowd and ensure a safe environment.
Talent services will coordinate with starred guests to ensure their comfort and timely arrivals.
An accessible lane will be provided for visually impaired guests, measuring 5 meters wide.
Security will ensure safety and manage crowd.
Talent services will coordinate with performers for the event.
An accessible lane will be provided for 5 meters.
Ensure all guests, including those using the accessible lane, are safely guided through the event.
Coordinate with talent to ensure they are comfortable and have a positive experience during their interactions with the media and fans.
Provide a designated accessible lane for individuals with disabilities, ensuring they can participate fully in the event.
Ensure safety and manage crowd flow.
Coordinate with talent for arrivals and departures.
